name: Three.js 3D Viewer
description: Demo interactive 3D viewer powered by Three.js, a popular JavaScript library for rendering 3D graphics in the browser. Generates and displays 3D scenes, models, and animations directly in the conversation.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Three.js 3D Viewer to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Three.js 3D Viewer to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://example-server.modelcontextprotocol.io/threejs/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: Does Three.js 3D Viewer MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Three.js 3D Viewer requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Three.js 3D Viewer is developed by Model Context Protocol Community. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
